name: Signal Cluster S14: EOD Filtering (Intraday to Daily Extract)
description: Tests: datetime_extract time_of_day, where() to extract EOD close from intraday bars, ffill to densify sparse EOD data, scatter for sparse visualization.
source:
# =============================================================================
# SIGNAL CLUSTER S14: EOD Filtering
# Tests: time_of_day extract, where() sparse filter, ffill densify
# =============================================================================

src = study_assets()
close = src.c

# === EOD DETECTION ===
bar_tod = datetime_extract(
    component=DatetimeExtractionType.time_of_day,
    timezone='America/New_York'
)(index())
is_eod = bar_tod == 960    # 16:00 ET = 960 minutes

# === EOD CLOSE EXTRACTION ===
# Sparse: ~252 values from thousands of intraday bars
daily_close = where(is_eod, close)

# Densify for line chart via ffill
daily_close_filled = ffill(daily_close)

# === EOD RETURN ===
eod_prev = daily_close_filled >> 1
eod_return = (daily_close_filled - eod_prev) / eod_prev

# === REPORTERS ===
xy_lines(
    title='EOD Close (ffilled from intraday)',
    category='EOD Filter',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Intraday Close', color=Color.LightGray),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='EOD Close (ffill)', color=Color.Blue)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(close, daily_close_filled))

event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        icon=Icon.ClockIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='EOD Close', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ],
        title='EOD Bar'
    )
)(daily_close, is_eod)
